body: Refreshed with main (5bdfc00c) via its refreshed parent #951 (3f490c97): merging #951 brought main in and was clean - the `doosan-dnm.cps` guard conflict was resolved on #951 (main's `chainCut()` guard, then the rotary feed word); this PR's own A-state change merged on top without a conflict. `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` stays main's 18. Tests, all green: doosan_dnm_post 7, doosan_dnm_a_state 2, rotary_feed_cap 5, fourth_axis_pose 9, conformance 6, post_unit_word 5, per_op_files 9, comment_escape 3, suppressed_rest 2, fanuc_post 11, drill_prior 12, drill_rplane 8. `cargo test -p camcraft-post --no-fail-fast` green except `script_tormach_plasma`, which fails identically on main 5bdfc00c (stale plasma refusal goldens). `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` and app clippy on the two touched suites clean. Mergeable: MERGEABLE. Ready for a re-check.
